title: Measured picture repairs use exact native slot geometry and preserve consent and hide constraints
steps: Run the production repair item and delivered-turn tests against the published Boxing 1.0.11 artifacts.
expect: The measured background resolves uniquely to module-161.2 and its native aspect 1.5 instead of the presentation aspect 2.813.
Unmatched paths, ambiguous slots and unmeasured fit do not invent a target.
The delivered turn preserves canHide:false and consent refusals, and explains fresh revisions and native content validation.

tests: a measured demo background gets the exact native contract replacement before a generic module write
explicit block and native image keys resolve only on the measured page
ambiguous image paths and duplicate native declarations do not invent a binding
unmatched paths, unrelated kinds and unmeasured native fit preserve the original fault
the delivered turn retains consent refusals and explains recoverable native write errors
